regulated_franchise.rationale: Finite-life common-distribution policy ending at the documented franchise or concession expiry with no terminal value.

mature_power_distribution.rationale: Shared continuing distribution policy for a mature power operator with a reviewed common payout.

operating_power.rationale: P/B screen pending a normalized post-transaction FCFF and complete capital bridge.

growth_renewable.rationale: P/B screen for a scaled renewable platform pending project-level operating, ownership, and financing reconciliation.

early_stage_renewable.rationale: P/B screen for a development-heavy renewable platform while announced and operating projects cannot yet be valued separately.

operating_solar.rationale: P/B screen for an operating solar platform pending project-level FCFF and debt allocation.

MER.route_reason: A reviewed common payout and renewed franchise support a finite-life distribution valuation without value beyond the 2053 franchise expiry.

sources.label: MER FY2025 PSE annual financial report

facts.distribution_derivation: PHP11.328 interim plus PHP16.672 final common dividends tied to FY2025 core earnings

FGEN.route_reason: FCFF remains primary, but the 2025 gas-business transaction prevents a normalized comparable cash-flow and capital bridge.

sources.label: FGEN FY2025 audited value translated in issuer PSE filing

facts.intrinsic_blocker: The 2025 sale and deconsolidation of 60% of the gas business require pro-forma owner-cash normalization and a complete debt, lease, minority, and preferred bridge.

ACEN.route_reason: Project SOTP/FCFF remains primary; P/B provides a finite screen pending project ownership, operating status, and financing reconciliation.

sources.label: ACEN FY2025 PSE annual financial report

facts.intrinsic_blocker: Operating, construction, and committed renewable projects are not yet separated into attributable project values with allocated financing and parent-only claims.

MWC.route_reason: A reviewed common payout and extended East Zone concession support a finite-life distribution valuation without value beyond January 2047.

sources.label: MWC FY2025 PSE annual financial report

facts.distribution_derivation: FY2025 regular common dividend; the PHP0.254 special dividend is excluded

SPC.route_reason: Reviewed recurring common dividends support a continuing distribution valuation while asset-level FCFF and contract lives remain unresolved.

sources.label: SPC FY2025 PSE annual financial report

facts.distribution_derivation: PHP0.40 June plus PHP0.80 December 2025 regular common dividends

CREC.route_reason: Project SOTP/FCFF remains primary; P/B provides a finite screen pending project ownership, operating status, and financing reconciliation.

sources.label: CREC FY2025 PSE annual financial report

facts.intrinsic_blocker: The 597.2 MW operating portfolio and development pipeline are not yet separated into attributable project values with allocated financing and parent-only claims.

ALTER.route_reason: Project SOTP/finite-life DCF remains primary; P/B provides a finite screen while project ownership and financing remain incomplete.

sources.label: ALTER FY2025 PSE annual financial report

facts.intrinsic_blocker: The operating and development projects cannot yet be valued separately with source-bounded ownership, remaining life, cash flows, and allocated project debt.

ASLAG.route_reason: Project FCFF remains primary; P/B provides a finite screen pending project-level cash flow and debt allocation.

sources.label: ASLAG FY2025 PSE annual financial report

facts.intrinsic_blocker: The four operating solar plants and development projects lack a completed project-level FCFF, remaining-life, and debt-allocation bridge.

SPNEC.route_reason: Project SOTP/finite-life DCF remains primary; P/B provides a finite screen while development assets and claims remain incomplete.

sources.label: SPNEC FY2025 PSE annual financial report

facts.intrinsic_blocker: Large development-stage assets and 2025 losses require project-by-project operating status, ownership, financing, and parent-claim reconciliation before intrinsic value.

MYNLD.route_reason: A reviewed common payout and current concession term support a finite-life distribution valuation without assuming the proposed extension beyond July 2037.

sources.label: MYNLD FY2025 PSE annual financial report

facts.distribution_derivation: PHP1.14 regular common dividend declared from FY2025 retained earnings
